summary: Lightspeed needs an AAP subscription and admin rights; the coding assistant also needs a watsonx Code Assistant subscription, API key, model ID and VS Code 1.70.1+, and the assistant needs an LLM on RHEL AI, OpenShift AI or AI Inference Server.
